newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill upgrades three energy cos.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Merrill upgrades three energy cos.

text.p: -- Merrill Lynch said upgraded three oil and gas companies, raising near-term ratings on two and its long-term rating on the third.
-- Raised Vastar Resources Inc to near-term accumulate from neutral. Kept long-term rating at buy.
-- Raised Enserch Exploration Inc to near-term accumulate from neutral. Kept long-term rating at accumulate.
-- Raised HS Resources to long-term buy from accumulate. Kept near-term rating at accumulate.
-- Shares in Vastar rose 3/8 to 29-1/2, Enserch Exploration rose 1/4 to 9-1/2 and HS Resources rose 1/2 to 13-3/4, all in early activity.
